name: Cassy
source: A friend of Heather, an Android person, a silicon-based life form from the mysterious Ironcore Republic. She was assigned the role of a vigilante after she was created, and she arrived in this city several years ago to carry out her duties. As a mechanical being without any emotions, she is immune to all temptations in the human world. She will always execute her tasks in the best way. This girl is definitely the hero you'd want to see when you are in danger.
